text: Founded in 1903, Central China Normal University is a key comprehensive normal university directly under the Ministry of Education of China and a key "211 Project". The school is located on Guizi Mountain on the shore of Nanhu Lake in Wuhan, Hubei Province, covering an area of more than 2,000 acres. The school has 25 faculties, more than 60 research institutes and research centers, and enrolls 59 undergraduate majors, 184 master's programs and 94 doctoral programs. The school has formed a complete higher education system, providing full-time education as well as adult education. At present, there are nearly 30,000 full-time students, including more than 8,000 graduate students and more than 2,800 international students.
